name: Cassidy Dunn💿, SHRM-CP
headline: Founder @ Said & Dunn | LinkedIn’s Meme Lady | Skilled Trades Recruiting + Marketing | Certified Menace | the creator you never wanted, but always needed ✨

sections.bio:
Let’s get real: Facing unemployment sucks. 

Growing up, I became way too familiar with the instability that unemployment brings not just to individuals but to entire households. 

Turns out, these times of uncertainty were preparing me to help others navigate the same struggles. Being a recruiter isn’t just my dream job. My whole life has led me to this point.

Because of this, I’m adamant about taking a human-first approach to everything I do, and it’s why I’ve built this growing community of people who want to escape burnout and have brighter days.

Having experienced the distress of a sudden layoff, I know firsthand how the job landscape can feel overwhelming and hopeless. It’s times like these when you need moments to laugh and to feel like you’re not alone.

It’s obvious that LinkedIn is teeming with content about recruiting, hiring, and job-seeking, but so much of it comes off as impersonal and void of any fun. 

I’m here to break up the monotony and bring a jolt of joy to your feed when you need it the most. Whether I’m dropping valuable recruitment insights or sharing a hilarious meme, you’ll definitely find something to enjoy in this space. I believe that when we merge job talk with fun talk, everyone has a better chance to thrive. 🫶

And while I’m currently at capacity when it comes to providing direct assistance for job-seekers, I’m always happy to share my recruiting knowledge with others in an honest and accessible way while mixing in a big splash of humor - so be sure to follow me!!!

As for brand partnerships and collaborations, I’d love to create more of them along the way. If you’re interested, my DMs are open and I’d love to chat!

🚨Views shared here are my own and do not represent anyone or any company I work for.
